overview: Two easy coastal towns a short drive down the East Coast Road. Mahabalipuram has UNESCO shore temples and rock carvings; Puducherry has a walkable French Quarter, a seafront promenade and relaxed cafés. Ideal for a long weekend with no flights.
fit: Very easy with a 4-year-old: short drives, flat walks and beaches, with plenty of breaks.
season: December to February is pleasant (24–30°C). April–June is hot and humid. October–November brings the northeast monsoon and occasional cyclones to this coast.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Mahabalipuram 55 km, then on to Puducherry 95 km along ECR
gettingThere.cost: ₹6,000–9,000 cab for the trip, or your own car

gettingAround: Hire a cab for the trip. In Puducherry, walk the White Town or rent bicycles; autos for longer hops.

todo.title: Krishna's Butterball and Arjuna's Penance

todo.title: Madras Crocodile Bank

todo.title: Paradise Beach
todo.why: Boat ride to a clean beach from Chunnambar

todo.title: Auroville Visitor Centre and Matrimandir viewpoint
todo.why: Calm gardens and a peek at the golden dome
todo.book: Inner chamber needs advance booking and is not for small kids

todo.title: Pondicherry Museum and Botanical Garden
todo.why: Toy train in the garden for the little one

stay.why: Walkable heritage stays near the beach
Pools and sand for the kids, between Chennai and Mahabs
Simple hotels close to the temples

foodTips: Very easy for vegetarians. Carry snacks for the drive; ECR has clean food stops.
save: Go on a long weekend so you need no leave
Choose a resort with breakfast and a pool
Skip paid tours; everything is walkable
safety: Swim only at Paradise Beach or where lifeguards are; Puducherry's rocky promenade is not for swimming
Watch the kids near the ECR traffic
health: Sunscreen and hats; the sun is strong
Carry ORS and water on the drive
kids: Do temples early morning before it heats up
Plan an afternoon rest at the hotel
Bring sand toys for the beach

days.plan: Drive to Mahabalipuram; Croc Bank, Shore Temple, Butterball at sunset
Drive to Puducherry; Paradise Beach; evening promenade
White Town cycling, botanical garden, drive home
